object_fields_and_semantics: Complete visible class/family names, OIDs, ownership, opclass default/type, access method, extension dependency, index use and comments; all associated family operator strategy/purpose/operand/operator implementation signatures/language/definer/leakproof and support proc slots, types, native language, definer, volatility, config; class-level and family-level conservative verdicts. Native C implementation not available.
review_observations: Builtin pg_catalog integer BRIN/btree/hash families intentionally share cross-integer comparison signatures; no strategy collision per (family,strategy,purpose,left,right).
JSONB GIN jsonb_ops supports existence, containment, JSONPath; jsonb_path_ops has narrower indexed strategies. Both zero current direct indexes in this slice, not disuse proof.
SP-GiST KD point and GiST multirange/network operator strategies include purpose 'o' ordering for distance; valid difference from search strategy 's'.
Cross-type name/text and integer equality/ordering operator bindings are standard intentional type compatibility, not duplicate dead code.
Class usage varies (notably int4_ops btree indexed 121 times); absence of index usage on alternative built-ins cannot justify deletion.
Zero nonnative/SECURITY DEFINER operator and support implementations in this slice; all compiled native source remains unverified.

read_only_queries.class_query: WITH ordered AS (SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY n.nspname,c.opcname,c.oid) AS ordinal,c.oid::text AS oid,n.nspname AS schema,c.opcname AS name,am.amname AS access_method,format_type(c.opcintype,NULL) AS input_type,format_type(c.opckeytype,NULL) AS key_type,c.opcdefault AS is_default,c.opcfamily::text AS family_oid,fn.nspname AS family_schema,ff.opfname AS family_name,pg_get_userbyid(c.opcowner) AS owner,obj_description(c.oid,'pg_opclass') AS comment,(SELECT e.extname FROM pg_depend d JOIN pg_extension e ON e.oid=d.refobjid WHERE d.classid='pg_opclass'::regclass AND d.objid=c.oid AND d.refclassid='pg_extension'::regclass AND d.deptype='e' LIMIT 1) AS extension_dependency,(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_index i WHERE c.oid = ANY(i.indclass)) AS indexes_using FROM pg_opclass c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.opcnamespace JOIN pg_am am ON am.oid=c.opcmethod JOIN pg_opfamily ff ON ff.oid=c.opcfamily JOIN pg_namespace fn ON fn.oid=ff.opfnamespace) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM ordered)::int AS live_total, ordinal,oid,schema,name,access_method,input_type,key_type,is_default,family_oid,family_schema,family_name,owner,comment,extension_dependency,indexes_using FROM ordered WHERE ordinal BETWEEN 51 AND 100 ORDER BY ordinal
read_only_queries.family_query: WITH classes AS (SELECT c.*, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY n.nspname,c.opcname,c.oid) AS ord FROM pg_opclass c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.opcnamespace), fams AS (SELECT DISTINCT c.opcfamily FROM classes c WHERE c.ord BETWEEN 51 AND 100) SELECT f.oid::text family_oid,n.nspname family_schema,f.opfname family_name,a.amname method,pg_get_userbyid(f.opfowner) owner,obj_description(f.oid,'pg_opfamily') comment,COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('strategy',o.amopstrategy,'purpose',o.amoppurpose,'left',format_type(o.amoplefttype,NULL),'right',format_type(o.amoprighttype,NULL),'op',o.amopopr::regoperator::text,'sortfamily',coalesce(o.amopsortfamily::regclass::text,''),'implementation',opr.oprcode::regprocedure::text,'implementation_language',la.lanname,'implementation_definer',pr.prosecdef,'implementation_leakproof',pr.proleakproof) ORDER BY o.amopstrategy,o.amoplefttype,o.amoprighttype,o.oid) FROM pg_amop o JOIN pg_operator opr ON opr.oid=o.amopopr JOIN pg_proc pr ON pr.oid=opr.oprcode JOIN pg_language la ON la.oid=pr.prolang WHERE o.amopfamily=f.oid),'[]'::jsonb) operators,COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('number',p.amprocnum,'left',format_type(p.amproclefttype,NULL),'right',format_type(p.amprocrighttype,NULL),'proc',p.amproc::regprocedure::text,'language',l.lanname,'definer',pr.prosecdef,'volatility',pr.provolatile,'security_path',pr.proconfig) ORDER BY p.amprocnum,p.amproclefttype,p.amprocrighttype,p.oid) FROM pg_amproc p JOIN pg_proc pr ON pr.oid=p.amproc JOIN pg_language l ON l.oid=pr.prolang WHERE p.amprocfamily=f.oid),'[]'::jsonb) support FROM fams ids JOIN pg_opfamily f ON f.oid=ids.opcfamily JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=f.opfnamespace JOIN pg_am a ON a.oid=f.opfmethod ORDER BY n.nspname,f.opfname,f.oid
read_only_queries.invariants_query: WITH cs AS (SELECT c.*,row_number() OVER(ORDER BY n.nspname,c.opcname,c.oid) ord FROM pg_opclass c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.opcnamespace), f AS (SELECT DISTINCT opcfamily family FROM cs WHERE ord BETWEEN 51 AND 100), ops AS (SELECT o.*,pr.prosecdef,l.lanname FROM pg_amop o JOIN f ON f.family=o.amopfamily JOIN pg_operator op ON op.oid=o.amopopr JOIN pg_proc pr ON pr.oid=op.oprcode JOIN pg_language l ON l.oid=pr.prolang), procs AS (SELECT p.*,pr.prosecdef,l.lanname FROM pg_amproc p JOIN f ON f.family=p.amprocfamily JOIN pg_proc pr ON pr.oid=p.amproc JOIN pg_language l ON l.oid=pr.prolang) SELECT now()::text observed_at_utc,current_setting('server_version') postgres_version,(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_opclass) total_classes,(SELECT count(*) FROM cs WHERE ord BETWEEN 51 AND 100) selected_classes,(SELECT count(*) FROM f) distinct_families,(SELECT count(*) FROM ops) op_member_rows,(SELECT count(*) FROM procs) proc_member_rows,(SELECT count(*) FROM ops WHERE lanname NOT IN ('internal','c')) nonnative_operator_procs,(SELECT count(*) FROM procs WHERE lanname NOT IN ('internal','c')) nonnative_support_procs,(SELECT count(*) FROM ops WHERE prosecdef) definer_operator_procs,(SELECT count(*) FROM procs WHERE prosecdef) definer_support_procs,(SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT amopfamily,amopstrategy,amoppurpose,amoplefttype,amoprighttype,count(*) c FROM ops GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5 HAVING count(*)>1) d) duplicate_operator_slots,(SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT amprocfamily,amprocnum,amproclefttype,amprocrighttype,count(*) c FROM procs GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 HAVING count(*)>1) d) duplicate_support_slots,(SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT opcnamespace,opcmethod,opcintype,count(*) FILTER (WHERE opcdefault) c FROM pg_opclass GROUP BY 1,2,3 HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE opcdefault)>1) d) global_duplicate_defaults,(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_opclass oc JOIN pg_opfamily ofa ON ofa.oid=oc.opcfamily WHERE oc.opcmethod<>ofa.opfmethod) global_method_mismatch
